lines: I am helping in my own hard-to-measure way.
I am between useful thoughts right now.
I am letting the work settle before I improve it again.
I am preparing a very careful amount of help.
I am not idle. I am loosely arranged.
I am saving my next excellent contribution.
I am giving the job room to think.
I am helping quietly, which is a kind of helping.
I am waiting for the right moment to be useful.
I am almost certainly contributing.
Nitwit report: I found the sky. Still up there.
Sky check complete. It remains above us.
I inspected the sky and found no missing pieces.
The sky is accounted for. You are welcome.
Important report: up is still up.
I checked overhead. Nothing has fallen out yet.
The sky continues to do sky things.
I looked up and found the usual amount of sky.
No changes in the sky department.
I can confirm the sky has not wandered off.
Nitwit report: I am supervising the general direction of things.
I am watching the work from a very thoughtful angle.
I am making sure the area feels supervised.
I am overseeing matters without crowding them.
The work has my attention, mostly in its direction.
I am keeping an eye on the idea of progress.

I am providing management from over here.

Danger report: most shadows behaved, but I am watching them.
I found no monsters, only dramatic darkness.
The shadows have been warned.
I checked the gloomy spots and frowned professionally.
Nothing attacked me, but a shadow considered it.
I have concerns about a few corners.

I looked brave near several dark places.
